arStrings.szText: While {c_important}Tenacity{/c} Charm equipped, you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life as {c_important}Barrier{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds when you {c_important}Block{/c} or {c_important}Dodge{/c}. Can only happen once every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} second.
